description: Holds the plugin's command-runner agent's Write to the session's scratchpad; a plugin agent's own hooks field is ignored, so it is registered here on every Write and checks the agent itself. Names a session from its first prompt, and after a compaction offers a handoff brief, listing the repo's brief files or, where it keeps none, naming the command that lists the board's issues. Refuses a Claude desktop side session started in a worktree with no source_branch, or with a brief that says nothing of how its branch lands, pointing at work-issue's hand-back. Each of those three does nothing where your Claude config folder's hooks/ already holds a copy. See each script's header in hooks/.
